description: Actor-targeted projectile creation; actor attack actions and full playable game remain unfinished.

decisions.reference: Unmodified original P_SpawnMissile compiled as host C, with controlled spawn/sound/angle/initial-step boundaries. The native side uses real WorldSpawn and the same canonical integer sine/RNG tables.
scope: Eight projectile types, zero/near/far target offsets and vertical differences
Angle wrap and all 256 shadow-spread random starts
Spawn, sound, angle and initial-step RNG positions
Integer travel-time velocity, owner handle and allocation cleanup
128 actual initial half-step, timer and RNG cases
Native NOBLOCKMAP flags and absence from block lists
Nine owner/type/inactive guards and callback-failure ownership cases

remaining: Actor attacks and complete action dispatch
Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
